title: Tuscan Crumbed Eggplant and Haloumi Burgers
subtitle: with Caramelised Onion and Rocket
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut half the eggplant into four 1cm-thick slices (see Kitchen 101). Thinly slice the onion. Slice the haloumi. Combine the breadcrumbs and Tuscan seasoning in a shallow dish and season with salt and pepper. Brush the eggplant slices with 1 tbs mayonnaise, then coat in breadcrumb mixture.

Bake eggplant: Put the crumbed eggplant on the lined tray and lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake on the upper oven shelf, turning halfway, for 20-25 mins until golden and very tender. While the eggplant is roasting, put the almonds in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Caramelise onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan over low heat. Cook the onion, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins or until soft and golden. Season with salt and pepper. Add 1 tbs balsamic vinegar and 1 tbs sugar and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until caramelised. Remove from the pan, then wipe the pan clean and reserve.

Toast rolls: Meanwhile, cut the rolls in half and put, cut-side up, on an oven tray. Lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake on the lower shelf for 3 mins or until lightly toasted. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the reserved pan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan.

Serve up: Put half the rocket, 1 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp balsamic vinegar in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Spread the roll tops with 1 tbs mayonnaise. Layer the bases with caramelised onion, eggplant, haloumi and remaining rocket. Sandwich with the tops. Divide burgers and dressed rocket among plates. Scatter with almonds and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Only 150g of eggplant is needed for this recipe. If your eggplant looks very large, you may want to check this by weighing the slices and keeping them 1cm-thick so they cook through in time.
